en: This is my sanctuary... Hidden from all.
Forever unseen by you, as further into{SAUT}love I fall. It is here, in this... in this...{SAUT}Um. I need to say what the sanctuary is!
A place to sleep, and dream...{OPTION}Just your own room.{OPTION}A shrine.
A place to sleep and dream? Like dream{SAUT}of the beloved?{PAGE}Yes, you can covet the sweet, forbidden{SAUT}fruit, and dreaming of it makes{SAUT}wherever you sleep your sanctuary...

Sure, that's the idea. But even more{SAUT}than your room, a true sanctuary is{SAUT}impossible for anyone else to enter.{PAGE}The place that's physically impossible{SAUT}for anyone else to enter is your dreams!{SAUT}So the sanctuary is one's bed...

That's close. A shrine is a special place,{SAUT}but I need a place where only I can{SAUT}enter. Like... my dreams! In my own bed!{PAGE}Yes, you can covet the sweet, forbidden{SAUT}fruit, and dreaming of it makes{SAUT}wherever you sleep your sanctuary...

When I'm with you, I masquerade as an{SAUT}angel even as envy burns within me...{PAGE}I am but an innocent who can't help her{SAUT}sinful love... You know, I think this is my{SAUT}greatest masterpiece yet...
GYAAAAAAAH! W-W-Why were you{SAUT}listening to me!?
Well, you were just saying it all{SAUT}out loud...{PAGE}And besides, do you really want to{SAUT}deny the world your art? Your beautiful{SAUT}words that make one weak in the knees?
Flattery's not gonna get you anywhere!{SAUT}...You really think it's beautiful?
I mean, I don't care! C'mon, let's go{SAUT}back, already. I'm tired.
